messages.subject: Combo boxes on 64-bit MacOS X (was: Re: Rose plot)
parts:
As it happens, Java Swing's File and Color chooser are terrible on the
mac. For this reason I have been using a 3rd party solution for the
File chooser (quaqua). With the plot builder I also added the Color
chooser. Apparently this broke the combo boxes on 64-bit Macs. I fixed
the issue (in the development version) by moving **more** of the GUI
elements over to quaqua. You can always disable quaqua through the
preferences.


Ian
